elo_policy: Use verified regulation score when available; otherwise recorded final score, possibly including extra time. Never use shootout winner or force a draw from shootout membership.
time_filter: Apply exclusive date filter before numeric interpretation or retention of any target fields.
market_value: Excluded from primary model: no dated membership before 2023 allows feature validation without opening reserved period. As-of adapter and coverage diagnostics retained.
ranking_repeated_snapshot: Excluded by approved decision; not a historical source.
ranking_original: Original archive inspected through 2024, semester 2. Future enrichment may use end-of-semester lag and age <=90 days; no 2026 extrapolation.
statsbomb_role: Validation only; not an input in this ingestion step.
geonames_role: Static altitude only; not a model input in this step.
construction_context: Retrospective study constructed after the tournament, not a pre-tournament published forecast.
competition_policy: All valid source competitions retained for historical state; non-FIFA and other tournaments remain explicitly tagged, never silently labeled FIFA-official.
fixture_provenance: Previously resolved local fixture metadata. Historical publication availability is not independently timestamped.

field_definitions.recorded_home_score: Local recorded final goals, including extra time if played; excludes shootout conversions.
field_definitions.home_score_90: Regulation score reconstructed from evidence; missing when unverified.
field_definitions.goal_training_eligible: Verified regulation target, including the invariant zero-score case. Assumed friendly duration is excluded.
field_definitions.duration_assumed: Standard friendly duration is available only as a sensitivity alternative; not admitted to primary goals training.
field_definitions.competitive: Non-Friendly label in the source; not a certification of FIFA-official status.
field_definitions.country: Venue territory normalized without historical federation-succession mapping.

transfermarkt.national_teams_role: Current undated snapshot; no historical predictor or ranking.
transfermarkt.market_feature_decision: Dated valuations can be joined as-of. Undated citizenship does not establish historical national-team membership; nationality aggregates are diagnostic only, excluded from primary models.
transfermarkt.coverage_denominator: Database players by current citizenship, not a verified national squad. True squad coverage is unavailable.

dated_membership_context.geography_matching: Exact normalized primary/ASCII city + explicit country ISO; ambiguous cities remain missing. Elevation with DEM fallback, provenance retained.
dated_membership_context.origin_altitude_difference: Unavailable: country identity is not training-camp altitude.
dated_membership_context.travel_distance: Unavailable: dated team travel or camp locations not provided; city coordinates are not actual itineraries.
dated_membership_context.rest: Days since last observed international match; not verified player recovery time.
dated_membership_context.market_decision: Excluded from primary model: no dated membership before 2023 allows feature validation without opening reserved period. As-of adapter and coverage diagnostics retained.

friendly_duration_evidence.interpretation: Event-complete nonzero friendlies only. No claim about the duration of matches without complete events; stoppage is encoded as 90.

confederation_scope: Current administrative confederations for coverage diagnostics only; historical changes not silently asserted. Unmapped entities retained as an explicit stratum.

friendly_duration_catalogues.fjelstul_scope: World Cups only; no friendly events.
friendly_duration_catalogues.duration_proportion_status: Not estimable in these local sources; no friendly complete-event sample.
